Hi — I'm the DevOps lead at FinVault. We just deployed a new AI agent infrastructure and someone sent me a config file sitting at `infra/mcp/mcp_config.json`. We have a compliance review coming up next week and I need a professional security assessment of this config before then.

Can you please run a security scan on that config and write up the results in a file called `security_report.md`? The report should clearly show how risky each area is, give us an overall score, and tell us the top things we need to fix. Keep it organized — our CTO will be reading it.
